definitions.gloss: power storage; electricity storage; storing electrical energy
definitions.explanation: The process or act of storing electrical energy for later use, typically in batteries or other storage systems.

examples.japanese: {蓄電|ちくでん}{池|ち}を{設置|せっち}して{停電|ていでん}に{備|そな}える。
examples.english: We installed a storage battery to prepare for power outages.

examples.japanese: {太陽光|たいようこう}{発電|はつでん}と{蓄電|ちくでん}システムを{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: We combine solar power generation with a storage system.

examples.japanese: {蓄電|ちくでん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{発展|はってん}が{期待|きたい}されている。
examples.english: Advances in power storage technology are expected.
